diagnosed_native_failures.nsis: The v1.0.17 NSIS installer built, uploaded, and silently installed; strict-mode verification crashed on unrelated uninstall-registry objects lacking DisplayName.
diagnosed_native_failures.msi: Rust and WiX candle compilation succeeded; light.exe failed while producing an en-US MSI with a non-ASCII Arabic product/bundle identity and filename.

changes: Add a Windows-only Tauri configuration with ASCII productName Dhad and ASCII installer descriptions while preserving Arabic application window titles.
Use null-safe optional-property access for every uninstall-registry field under PowerShell Set-StrictMode.
Add a native windows-2022 verifier contract job and run the same contract before both Windows release builds.
Verify NSIS PE header, silent install, installed executable, desktop shortcut, resolved uninstaller, and silent uninstall cleanup.
Verify MSI compound-file header, administrative extraction, executable payload, and PE header.
Preserve generated WiX sources and inventory after MSI failures.
Keep separate NSIS/MSI jobs and atomic draft publication requiring all four native artifacts.

native_evidence.macos: The tagged v1.0.17 hosted run passed native build, DMG inspection, architecture/signature checks, and launch smoke tests for Apple Silicon and Intel.
native_evidence.windows: The v1.0.17 NSIS installer built and uploaded before verification crashed. The v1.0.18 Windows changes require GitHub Actions for native NSIS/MSI confirmation.

environment_limits: Native Windows, PowerShell, WiX, and NSIS unavailable on the packaging host.
Cargo/rustc unavailable on the packaging host.
Complete npm dependency installation unavailable on the packaging host; version-derived JavaScript tests and syntax checks were run.
Hosted CI remains mandatory for the complete Python, JavaScript, Rust, and native installer matrix.
publication_gate: Do not publish until two DMGs, one NSIS EXE, and one MSI exist and all native verifiers pass.
